publish_schedule.note: Longform Cursor Automation: 4 weekday slots YEKT (owner 9–17). NOT 20:00. Daily short posts on site — отдельный поток. Publish only when FTP secrets + EXCALIBUR_BLOG_ALLOW_PUBLISH=yes on process (never git).

run_budget.comment: Hard caps on billed Derouter/Kie work per article run. NO wall-clock kill — soft note only after wall_clock_soft_note_minutes. cover_qa_image_attempts_max=2: initial canvases + one panel regen; third QA cycle forbidden. derouter_image_jobs_max=3: e.g. 2 quad canvases + 1 panel fix. derouter_chat_retries_per_call_max=1: one HTTP 524/5xx retry per script invocation (Writer chunk parts are separate invocations). kie_image_fallback_max=1: one Kie fallback per run then STOP.
